name: mirage
text: Two places in the app: (1) Settings > Diagnostics & about > Show report: it has an 'All-time profit (wallet)' line with cash, open cost and each ledger kind's total and count, e.g. TRANSFER_IN +250.00 (2). Share it with me and I can check it row by row. (2) The Engine tab shows the engine's wallet cash, equity and open positions. I haven't tried a raw ledger view, so I can't promise there's a screen for it.
